name: Yudashi Peril: Floraison
source: The year is 2013, and Homura Asano is trying to get by as a second year at the prestigious Ainami Academy. Up until the beginning of the second semester, she hasn't had much in the way of friends, hasn't participated in any clubs, and has never had a girlfriend. Most of all, she has a strong premonition that she will not live to see her third year. Is it possible to change the course of her life and avert this fate?
translation: 2013年，Homura Asano正努力熬过知名的Ainami学园二年级生活。直到第二学期开学，她都没交到多少朋友，没有参加任何社团，也从未交过女朋友。最重要的是，她有一种强烈的预感：自己活不到三年级。她能否改变人生的轨迹，避开这一命运？
